en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing four men posed in front of a plain backdrop. Two men sit at a table covered with a dark cloth that holds papers, an ink bottle, and a stamp or seal. One seated man wears a light-colored traditional long coat; the other wears a Western-style suit. Behind them stand a man in a military-style uniform with a cross‑body strap and another man in worn, loose clothing. The card edges are aged and stained. Along the right vertical border, faint printed or stamped text is visible, including the word 'PATIA' (likely part of a longer word such as 'PATIALA' or similar). Handwritten script appears near the lower right edge.
